Flareon:*turning the heat up*” glaceon I’m telling you it needs to be warm!”

Glaceon:*turing the heat down*” well I’m telling you it’s too hot and it’s summer!”

Jolteon:*listening to things like thudnerbringer and electric shuffle in the boom box*” yeah this is electric!!”

Espeon:*meditating*”when will our trainer wake up?”

Leafeon:*siitng next to the plants at the window*” hey someone get some water I think I’m photoscynthesizing!”

Sylveon:*annoying umbreon*” umbreon wake up umbreon umbreon!”

(If you say your in love with any of them the. I will beat you in a battle !)
